description: This PHP source file defines the ClaimRequestActionAPI class, an API endpoint for performing actions (such as submit, approve, pay, cancel, reject) on claim requests within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for handling update requests, validation, and internal state management related to claim request workflows.

classes.name: ClaimRequestActionAPI
classes.description: API endpoint class for handling actions on claim requests such as submit, approve, reject, pay, and cancel within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to perform an action on a specific claim request, updating its status according to the action parameter.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Returns validation rules for the update method, ensuring request ID is positive and action is within allowed actions.

methods.name: getResultingState
methods.description: Internal method to determine the new state of a claim request based on the action taken and the user's allowed actions.
